format_contract_for_an_independent_parse: Preserve plugin class ID, parameterID, representation attributes, document page order, blank cell positions, layer order, duplicate parameter bindings and title variants.
Treat binding identity as the declared plug-in class ID plus parameterID; do not derive identity from a title or cell position.
The index deliberately preserves IDs as strings without inventing numeric ranges or normalization.
